name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success & Merchant Partner Manager | Retention, Upsell & E-Commerce Expertise
summary: Client success and account management professional with 15+ years managing post-sale partner relationships, driving retention, upsell, and account health across SaaS, agency, and e-commerce environments. Deep marketing-technology and e-commerce expertise, paired with direct financial-services client experience. Manages account health in Salesforce and serves as the cross-functional bridge between partners and internal product, marketing, and operations teams.

bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, identifying opportunities to expand retainer scope and recommending complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across marketing, sales, and operations.
Architect and manage CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene protocols.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners in Salesforce (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, analyzing utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client end to end and helped pursue a major banking prospect in the northeastern U.S., reaching finalist stage in that deal.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

Built and launched e-commerce websites for established retail businesses adding a bigger online storefront as a secondary revenue line, while onboarding 25+ clients per month and holding 120% of sales targets.
